Name: Nixx-Mesen
Description: Download, update, launch, BIOS and save integration for Mesen (MesenCE), the accurate multi-system emulator: NES, Famicom Disk System, Super Nintendo, Game Boy, Game Boy Advance, PC Engine, Master System, Game Gear, ColecoVision and WonderSwan.
Credits: Many thanks to Sour, who wrote Mesen, and to the nesdev community who carry it on as MesenCE.
